newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly unchanged.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely unchanged on Wednesday, with only the two-month rate slightly up, traders said.
"Nobody wants to move," a foreign bank dealer said.
Banks are waiting for the March inflation figure which would determine the direction of domestic interest rates, traders said.
This week government officials said they expected the March inflation, which may be announced on Friday or Monday, to be not significantly different from the 4.4 percent February figure.
